name: General
description: General purpose layouts for common presentation elements.

ai.when_to_use: Default fallback theme. Pick this when the deck's subject is mixed or unclear, or when the content needs layout shapes the other themes don't cover (quotes, tables, comparisons, process steps, team grids).
ai.avoid_when: The deck has a strong, consistent visual identity to hit — a launch pitch, a formal report, or a fast internal update are better served by modern, standard, or swift.
